5.evidence_source: Data collection took place between December 2014 and June 2015 in seven large universities in Tehran (University of Tehran, Sharif University of Technology, Shahid Beheshti University, Tarbiat Modarres University, Islamic Azad University, Shahed University, and Iran University of Medical Sciences).
5._section_summary: This section describes translation/back-translation of the BAS-2 into Persian and ethical approval, followed by data collection from December 2014 to June 2015 at seven universities in Tehran. University students were approached in classroom settings and completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire (BAS-2 counterbalanced with other measures); participation was voluntary and unremunerated. The section does not number studies (no 'Study 1' etc.), does not report sample size, age, BMI, race/ethnicity, or correlations.

6.evidence_source: The present study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran.
6._section_summary: This paper evaluated the factor structure and psychometric properties of the Persian BAS-2 in an Iranian university (college) sample, finding a one-factor structure, internal consistency, and small sex differences (men higher than women). The BAS-2 showed convergent validity with self-esteem and life satisfaction, a negative association with BMI in women and positive associations with BMI in men, and limitations included university sampling and use of self-reported BMI.
